text: Artificial Intelligence is developing quickly. Today we have "narrow AI" that can do one task well, like translating languages. But many researchers are working on "Artificial General Intelligence" (AGI), a machine that could learn and think like a human. AGI could bring huge benefits, such as curing diseases and solving climate change. However, there are also serious risks, including job loss and safety problems if we lose control of such a powerful system. Experts disagree about the timeline. Some believe AGI may arrive within 20 years, while others think it is much further away, or may never happen at all.
